4. Scope and decisions. `git diff --stat master...HEAD` shows api_today.py, daily.py, checks/s3.py, test_flow.py (3 lines), server/cache/twin_supply.json and web/index.html. The server files come from the server half's earlier commits on this branch. The page commits (23ff84b..798ac2e) touch only web/index.html. Nothing contradicts spec/v2-decisions.md: no class, teacher, join or homework code, the only College Board link is registration, and the only extra hex colour is #FFFFFF.

defects.what: Question tables are invisible on Today. ui.css:1868 sizes `.q-table` with `width:0; min-width:100%`. The page's `.td :where(*)` rule has the same specificity, loads later, and resets min-width to 0. So every table in a question of the day, an in-column twin or Up next question 1 renders 0px wide, leaving a blank gap. Measured on today's grid-in question ("The table shows the distribution…"): the .q-table is 0×330, so the student has to answer without the data.
defects.fix: Exclude the question from the reset, e.g. `.td :where(*:not(.q-table))` or add `.td .q-table { min-width: 100%; }`. Re-check that the table is visible at 1280 and 390.

defects.what: Check 18 fails. On a plan rest day the rest lead counts as a lead, so "Practice anyway · 45 min" renders as a grey .btn (rgb(233,229,223)). The spec wants an orange pill: brief lines 193 and 2031, and check 18 "an orange pill Practice anyway". Reproduced with a plan whose today is off.
defects.fix: Use `pill` when the only lead is the rest-day lead (e.g. `(hasLead && !(pday && pday.kind === 'rest') ? btn : pill)`).

defects.what: T19.4 fails: a real 70px left touch swipe at 390 never switches to the Grid-in tab. The panel has default touch-action, so the browser takes the pan and fires pointercancel instead of pointerup. Measured events: pointerdown:touch, then pointercancel:touch. The same swipe with a synthetic pointerup does switch tabs.
defects.fix: Add `touch-action: pan-y` to the swipe panel (.qd-slot at <760px), or track touchstart/touchend instead of pointerup.

defects.what: The exam trigger repeats the year for any date outside this year: "Sat, Mar 6, 2027, 2027 ▾". UI.date(...,'long') already includes the year, and the page appends it again.
defects.fix: Drop the appended year or append it only when UI.date leaves it out.

defects.what: Opening the target sheet sends POST /api/plan/preview for quick targets below the learner's current score. Each returns 422 "target must be at least current", so the console shows 2 errors and the 500 chip has no Steady/Ambitious tag.
defects.fix: Skip previews for quick targets below `current`, or tag them without a request.

defects.where: web/index.html paintScore (empty state with added scores)
defects.what: With a Bluebook score added, the Score card says "No score yet" while its trend says "1 scored sitting" with the diamond. The empty state also repeats itself: two Module buttons ("Module · 22 questions · 35 min" and "Module · 22 q · 35 min") and two "Add a score" links. For a new code it shows zero evidence rows ("Algebra 0 (thin)…"). This goes against decision 7 (one fact once, hide zeros). The server's /api/today score is null despite the outside score.
defects.fix: Say one thing when only added scores exist, show each door once, and hide zero evidence rows. Ask the server half whether an added Math score should fill `score`.

defects.where: web/index.html examPop/targetSheet previewFor (days default '1111100') vs workload
defects.what: For a learner with no plan, the exam card says "54 study days" for Nov 21. The target sheet and exam popover say about 40 for the same date, because previewFor defaults days to Mon–Fri. That is two different numbers for one idea on the same screen.
defects.fix: Pass the same days/minutes the workload uses (or omit days so the server uses its default).

defects.what: Decision 7 repetitions: a rest day shows "Rest day in your plan" in the header and "Rest day" in the lead; a new code shows "No streak yet" in both the hero and the Study card; the plan's week theme line shows a raw ISO date ("Build · Math practice · Test 2026-09-27").
defects.fix: Say each once. Format the theme's date (or ask S7 for a formatted theme).

defects.where: web/index.html dayDetail (future day with no plan)
defects.what: A future day whose row has a `due` object with no check-ins shows only the date. The "Nothing planned yet." fallback is skipped because `row.due` is truthy.
defects.fix: Treat a due with no checks/fading as empty.

defects.what: The "What it takes" block reuses the page root class `td`. That borrows `.td { padding-bottom:110px }` (a 110px gap in the sheet) and the min-width reset.
defects.fix: Give it its own class and scope the shared line/sub styles to it.

defects.where: dialog ids (targetSheet in web/index.html, try-one from F3's UI.twinSheet)
defects.what: Checks 21 and 25 name dialog#targetSheet and dialog#tryOne. The dialogs work but carry no id, because UI.sheet takes no id.
defects.fix: Add a className/id hook through UI.sheet (F1) or set the id after creation, so the checks' selectors match.

defects.what: Checkpoint ca5c6e2 committed a generated cache file (S8's compete.py, guarded by bank hash) that is outside S3's files. test_flow.py also has a 3-line change from the server half (SEC-02 backdating and a tuple compare) and is not an S3-owned file.
defects.fix: Drop the cache file from the branch or have S8 gitignore server/cache/. Have the owner confirm the test_flow change.
